decision: Link fixup documents from the original Markdown spec
rationale: The user explicitly requests finding corrections outside Nessa UI. Add a dated fixup index near the top of the original spec, relative Markdown links, and back-links in each correction document. Document the same authoring rule in issue intake and sl-learn. These explanatory links preserve existing acceptance and immutable review history. Record the document amendment against the current seal.

discovery.observation: Fixups are visible in Nessa UI but the original spec does not link to correction documents for readers on GitHub or in an editor.
discovery.cause: Prior corrections were described inline and linked only through ledger/UI records.
